poems: Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
Write it down and it takes shape.
Sit down first — the ideas will find their way.
Today is worth taking seriously too.
Time remembers the words you write.
No rush — the road grows as you walk.
Work quietly, then talk about it.
Let the important thing happen first.
statDocsTip: Number of documents in the whole workspace
statDurationTip: SiYuan does not track usage time, so the plugin accumulates it locally: only counted while the window is visible and you are active
statWordsTip: Counted per block: blocks created or changed today, using their current length
statSinceToday: Usage time starts counting locally from today
statUnavailableTip: The SiYuan kernel SQL endpoint did not respond
emptyRecentTip: Open a document and it will show up here
notePlaceholder: Write down what is on your mind…
noteEmptyTip: Type your first idea in the box above
noteMirrorFailed: Saved locally, but failed to write into the SiYuan notebook
searchHint: Type a keyword to search titles and content
setUserNameDesc: The name shown on the first line of the greeting
setSuffixModeDesc: What the second line of the greeting shows
setCustomLineDesc: Used when "Always use the line below" is selected. In daily mode it joins the rotation pool
setBackgroundDesc: A SiYuan asset path (assets/xxx.png) or a direct image URL (https://…). Leave empty to use the theme background
setDimDesc: Percentage 0-80; raise it when the background image is too bright
setCardsDesc: Card management: uncheck to remove a card from the homepage, check again to bring it back. Order is arranged by dragging on the homepage
setSearchDesc: Show a search box under the greeting to search document titles and content
setRecentCountDesc: How many items the "Recent" card shows, from 3 to 30
setNoteCountDesc: How many items the "Quick Notes" card shows, from 3 to 30
setCardSizeResetDesc: All cards back to their default size (Recent / Notes / Calendar / Stats at 1/4 width, Quick access full width)
setNoteTargetDesc: Where a new note is written: keep it local, file it into a notebook, or append it to one specific document
noteTargetHintNone: Notes stay in the plugin's private storage and sync with SiYuan cloud
noteTargetHintNotebook: Each note becomes its own document in that notebook
noteTargetHintDoc: Each note is appended as a list item at the end of that document
setWeekStartDesc: Which weekday is the first column of the calendar
setDailyPathDesc: Path used when creating a daily note from an empty calendar day. Supports {yyyy} {MM} {dd} {yyyy-MM-dd}
setOpenOnLaunchDesc: When on, SiYuan switches to the homepage the next time it starts. An already-open homepage tab is focused instead of duplicated. Not applied on mobile, in read-only mode, or during the first-run wizard
setResetDesc: Restore every setting to its default value (your notes are kept)
obIntro: Take a minute to make it yours. Everything can be changed later in the plugin settings.
obNameDesc: This name appears in the homepage greeting.
obCardsDesc: Choose the cards you want on the homepage. You can drag them into order afterwards.
obBgDesc: Optional. Leave it empty to use the SiYuan theme background.
obDoneDesc: You can change everything later in Settings → Plugins → Forest Homepage → Settings.
setUsageResetDesc: Usage time is accumulated locally by the plugin (SiYuan does not track it). Clearing it resets "Time today" to zero
quickEmptyTip: Use “+” in the card header to pick a document, or click the pin on any row in Recent
quickDropHere: Drop documents here to file them into this group
quickGroupNamePlaceholder: Group name, e.g. Frequently used this week
quickGroupTip: Groups only categorise pinned documents; your notebooks are untouched
quickGroupDeleted: Group deleted; {n} pinned item(s) moved to Unfiled
quickGroupDeleteTip: Its documents fall back to Unfiled and stay pinned
setQuickItemMinDesc: Minimum width per item. The wider the quick access card, the more columns it fits
setQuickManageDesc: Pinned documents and their groups. Removing here never deletes documents from SiYuan
